description: 🔴 CREATING PUBLISHES IT — the alias is live for your tenant the moment this returns. Pass enabled=false to author one without arming it. `name` is the short leaf only ("cheap"); the server prepends "client:<your-brand>/" and that prefix cannot be supplied, so your alias can never collide with spideriq/*, agent/* or opvs/*. Every slot MUST name integration_id — one of YOUR OWN provider keys (see the brand integrations surface for ids) — because that key is what funds the slot; there is no default, since the convenient wrong answer to "who pays?" is our pool. Slots are an ORDERED fallback chain, first to last. Requires the admin role: a member may read aliases but not arm one.

enabled.description: Default true — and true means LIVE. Send false to author without arming.

name.description: Short leaf only, e.g. "cheap". Lowercase a-z0-9 plus - and _, max 64 chars.

slots.description: Ordered fallback chain, 1–16 entries. Slot 0 is tried first.

enabled.description: Default true. A disabled slot is skipped.

integration_id.description: YOUR OWN provider key (api_integrations.id) that funds this slot.

name: gate_client_alias_create
